g.text: LEZ-001 - Business flow: a planning day with low-emission zones (BF-04..BF-07)
Import / create orders for delivery date D
Assign an EV or another allowed vehicle
Move the order to another date / time window
Keep the order unassigned, inform the customer
Unassigned for LEZ or route not COMPLIANT?
Fix the plan, then send again
Mark orders inside enabled zones (LEZ badge)
Optimise: in-zone orders only on allowed vehicles
(stops, depot, road path of every leg)
Re-check each route with CURRENT data
Open route: map shows the certified server path
